body: Orchestrator (2026-11-16): attempt 1 is held unreviewed while an integration helper diagnoses the run-2 tool error `vitest interrupted 3 runs in a row without a failing test` (fireguard/src/vitestLane.mjs:150). Suspected interaction between DM-273's vitest.config.ts `projects` (unit + git with sequence.groupOrder 1) and the lane's bail:1 retry logic. The fix is not a test-file change, so it lands as an integration fix on space-sprint-1 (branch space-fg-interrupt), after which the next DM-198 attempt grades the new head. The 7 mutant-killing tests in 99d7f4c carry over.
